lesson_title: From a Village School to a Skilled Job
hook_text: No one in Sipho's family finished school. Here is how he became the first.
clip_script: Sipho's mum sells vegetables. His dad has no job. Nobody in the family finished school. Step one: a no-fee school and a hot meal every day, so he can concentrate. Step two: matric, with maths. Step three: no money for college, so his teacher helps him apply for an NSFAS bursary. Step four: a TVET course and an apprenticeship, earning while he learns. Today Sipho is a qualified electrician. He pays for his sister's school costs and plans his own business. That is what education does: it breaks the cycle of poverty, so the next generation starts higher.
visual_style: A whiteboard ladder climbing out of a village, each rung labelled with a programme, ending at a stick figure with a toolbox and a small business sign.
mood: Hopeful and determined, a real-world success path.
pacing: Steady step-by-step climb with a pause at each rung.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your own three-step skills plan.
